ui.lead: Bulk-downloads photos and videos from public Instagram profiles.
ui.detect_hint: A username, a profile link, or a link to a single post, reel, story or highlight.
ui.paste_hint_desktop: Click the box and press Ctrl+V.
ui.paste_hint_mobile: Long-press the box and choose Paste.
ui.mode_single_desc: A single photo, video or carousel
ui.mode_profile_desc: All of this person's posts, in bulk
ui.mode_profile_desc_owner: The whole profile of the person who shared this
ui.only_new_desc: If the profile was fully downloaded before, only posts shared since then are checked, which is much faster. Turn it off to scan the whole profile again; files already downloaded are still not downloaded twice.
ui.form_need_link: Paste a username or an Instagram link first.
ui.form_need_mode: Choose what to download: only this post or the whole profile?
ui.sub_login_open_desktop: Log in to Instagram in the window that opened. It closes by itself once you're logged in.
ui.sub_login_open_mobile: Log in to Instagram in the window that opened; it closes by itself when done. Use 'Hide' to minimize it or 'Close' to cancel.
ui.sub_starting: The first start can take a few seconds.
ui.sub_collecting: Posts are downloaded as they are found. Scanning is deliberately slow so Instagram doesn't block it.
ui.note_verify_body_desktop: Complete the verification (code, confirmation or puzzle) in the browser window that opened. The program is waiting and will continue by itself.
ui.note_verify_body_mobile: Complete the verification in the window that opened; the app is waiting and will continue by itself. If you hid the window, reopen it with the button below.
ui.note_login_wall: Without logging in, Instagram only shows part of this profile. To download everything, log in once and start again with the same link. Files already downloaded won't be downloaded again. Using a secondary account instead of your main one is safer.
ui.note_rate_limited: Instagram asked us to slow down because of too many requests in a short time. Wait a while (at least half an hour) and start again with the same link; it continues where it left off.
summary.unmatched: {n} posts skipped because they didn't match your choice
link.empty: Paste a username or an Instagram link first.
link.other_site: This isn't an Instagram link. This program only works with Instagram (instagram.com).
link.threads: This is a Threads link. This program only works with Instagram (instagram.com).
link.not_found: No username or Instagram link found in the text. Paste the profile address or the @username.
link.username_too_long: Instagram usernames are at most 30 characters. Check the name.
link.no_target: This link doesn't point to a specific profile or post. Open the profile or post and copy its link.
link.post_broken: The post link looks incomplete or broken. Copy the whole link.
link.explore: This is an Explore page link. Paste a link to a profile or a post.
link.direct: This is a direct message link. Messages can't be downloaded; paste a link to a profile or a post.
link.share_detected: Share link detected. What it points to will be clear once it's opened.
engine.single_needs_post: This is a profile link. To download a single post, paste the post's own link or choose 'The whole profile'.
engine.share_to_profile: The share link opened a profile. To download the whole profile, choose 'The whole profile'.
engine.unexpected_summary: An unexpected error occurred. Details are in the log below.
engine.login_done: The login window was closed. Not logged in.
engine.login_done_ok: Logged in to Instagram. This account will be used for the next downloads.
engine.folder_failed: Could not create the download folder: {path} ({error})
engine.account_yes: Working with the logged-in Instagram account.
engine.account_no: Working without an Instagram login. For some profiles only the first posts may be visible.
engine.finding_owner: Finding the profile of the person who shared this…
engine.owner_not_found: The profile of the person who shared this could not be found.
engine.avatar_failed: Could not get the profile picture: {error}
engine.private: This account is private. Posts of private accounts can only be downloaded when logged in with an account that follows it.
engine.private_logged_in: This account is private and the account you're logged in with doesn't follow it. Its posts can't be downloaded.
engine.nothing_selected: Nothing was selected to download. Tick at least one option in the settings.
engine.stories_need_login: You need to log in to Instagram to download stories.
engine.highlights_need_login: You need to log in to Instagram to download highlights.
engine.stories_skipped_login: Stories skipped: viewing them requires a login.
engine.highlights_skipped_login: Highlights skipped: viewing them requires a login.
engine.no_stories: This person has no active stories right now (stories disappear after 24 hours).
engine.highlight_not_found: This highlight could not be found. It may have been deleted or be private.
engine.only_new: This profile was fully downloaded before; only new posts are being checked.
engine.no_list: Could not get the list of posts from the profile. The Instagram page may not have loaded or its layout may have changed. Try again later; if it keeps happening, send the log from 'Details'.
engine.login_wall: Without a login, Instagram only showed {n} posts. To download all of them, log in once with 'Log in to Instagram' and start again.
engine.login_wall_total: Without a login, Instagram only showed {n} posts (the profile has {total}). To download all of them, log in once with 'Log in to Instagram' and start again.
engine.up_to_date: Checked for new posts ({n} posts checked); older ones were already downloaded.
engine.quality_plain: Video quality: {res} — Instagram offered no higher version for this video
engine.quality_fallback: Couldn't get the highest quality stream, downloading the normal version ({res}): {error}
skip.no_video: no video address; it may have been deleted or restricted
fetch.html_page: The server returned a page instead of a file (access may be blocked).
browser.load_failed: Could not load the browser component: {error}
browser.none: No browser could be opened. Edge's installation may be broken and the backup browser couldn't be downloaded either. Check your internet connection and reopen the program. Details: {detail}
browser.edge_broken: Edge on this computer looks incomplete (an unfinished update). Another browser will be used.
browser.profile_in_use: The browser profile is in use by another window. If another Instagram Downloader window is still open, close it and try again.
browser.opened: {name} opened. Don't close this window until the job is done.
browser.closed: The browser window was closed. The job was stopped.
browser.no_internet: No internet connection, or Instagram can't be reached.
browser.slow: The page is loading slowly; continuing with what's there.
browser.verify: Instagram is asking for verification. Complete it in the browser window that opened; the program is waiting.
browser.verify_timeout: Verification wasn't completed within 15 minutes. Try again.
browser.verify_failed: Instagram still refused the requests after verification. Wait a while and try again.
browser.login_required: You need to log in to Instagram for this.
browser.profile_login_required: Instagram doesn't show this profile to visitors who aren't logged in. Log in once with 'Log in to Instagram' and start again.
browser.post_login_required: Instagram doesn't show this post to visitors who aren't logged in. Log in once with 'Log in to Instagram' and start again.
browser.session_expired: The Instagram session seems to have ended. Log in again with 'Log in to Instagram'.
browser.rate_limited: Instagram isn't allowing more requests for now because there were too many in a short time. Wait a while and try again.
browser.slow_down: Instagram refused the {what} request (HTTP {code}); retrying in {s} seconds…
browser.user_not_found: No Instagram account named @{name} was found. Check the name; the account may have been deleted or renamed.
browser.profile_failed: Could not get the details of @{name}. The Instagram page may not have loaded; try again a bit later.
browser.strategy_failed: Couldn't get the list this way, trying another way. ({detail})
browser.scrolling: Collecting posts by scrolling the profile page…
browser.post_not_found: This post could not be found. It may have been deleted, belong to a private account, or the link may be wrong.
browser.share_failed: The share link didn't open a post or a profile. Make sure the link is correct.
browser.login_open: The Instagram login page is open. Log in; the window closes by itself when done.
browser.login_already: Already logged in. To switch accounts, log out in the window and log in with the other account.
chromium.downloading: Downloading the program's own browser (about 150 MB, only the first time). This can take a few minutes…
chromium.failed: Could not download the browser component. Check your internet connection. {detail}
server.no_folder_dialog: The folder picker is only available on Windows. You can type the path into the box.
server.folder_dialog_title: Choose the folder to save downloads to
app.edge_broken_box:
Edge on this computer looks broken (possibly an unfinished update).

The program is downloading its own browser (about 150 MB, only this once). The window will open by itself in a few minutes.
app.download_failed_box: Could not download the browser component. Check your internet connection and reopen the program.
app.window_failed_box: The window couldn't be opened. Open this address in your browser: {url}
engine.repairing: {n} videos had no address in the list; opening them one by one…
summary.unavailable: {n} posts couldn't be downloaded because they were deleted or restricted
ui.note_login_tip: Using a secondary account instead of your main one is safer.
browser.page_refused: Instagram refused to open the page (HTTP {code}); retrying in {s} seconds…
browser.refused: Instagram refused the {what} request (HTTP {code}); continuing another way.
engine.rate_limited_partial: Instagram didn't give the rest of the list for now; {n} posts were found and downloaded. Start again with the same link after a while (at least half an hour) to get the rest; files already downloaded won't be downloaded again.
summary.known: {n} posts had already been downloaded before (history)
engine.history_failed: Couldn't open the download history; continuing without it: {error}
engine.history_known: {n} posts from this profile were downloaded before; they won't be downloaded again.
engine.resume_found: The scan of this profile stopped halfway last time; after checking for new posts it will continue where it left off.
engine.auto_wait: Instagram stopped us for now. Waiting {m} minutes, then continuing where it left off ({n}/{total}). Press Stop if you don't want to wait; starting again with the same link also continues where it left off.
engine.auto_resume: Wait is over, continuing where it left off.
engine.session_expired_partial: Instagram ended the session (it can do that after many posts are browsed). The {n} posts found were downloaded. Log in again with 'Log in to Instagram' (with another account if you like) and start with the same link: it continues where it left off and doesn't download anything twice.
browser.resuming: Reached the part downloaded before; continuing from where it stopped last time…
browser.resume_failed: Couldn't continue from where it stopped; scanning the list in order instead (nothing is downloaded twice).
browser.pause: Short break so Instagram doesn't get overloaded: {s} seconds…
ui.history_desc: Doesn't download again what was downloaded before (even with another account or into another folder) and continues an unfinished scan where it left off.
ui.history_confirm: Clear the download history? Downloaded files are not deleted; the program only forgets what it downloaded.
ui.auto_title: If Instagram stops us, wait and continue
ui.auto_desc: Instagram asks for breaks during bulk downloads. When on, the program waits (15 minutes) and continues where it left off by itself.
ui.status_waiting_rate: Instagram asked for a break — continuing by itself in {t}
browser.highlights_from_page: Couldn't get the highlight list directly; reading it from the profile page…
engine.highlights_partial: Instagram didn't give {n} highlights for now: {names}. Start again with the same link after a while; only the missing ones will be downloaded.
android.no_gallery_app: Couldn't open a gallery app. Downloads are in Gallery › DCIM › Instagram.
android.no_window: The app screen is closed. Open the app and try again.
android.notif_verify: Instagram asks for verification. Open the app.
browser.login_open_mobile: The Instagram login page is open. Log in; the window closes by itself when done. Use 'Hide' to minimize it or 'Close' to cancel.
browser.verify_mobile: Instagram asks for verification. Complete it in the window that opened; the app is waiting.
ui.speed_hint: The careful modes go easier on Instagram but are slower. Try them if you often see "Instagram asked for a break".
ui.network_hint: Switching between Wi-Fi and mobile data changes your IP address. It can help if Instagram has put a limit on you.
ui.cookies_hint: Logs you out of Instagram. The phone will look like a new device.
ui.confirm_cookies: Instagram cookies will be deleted and you will be logged out. You will have to log in again.
server.report_copied: Report copied to the clipboard ({n} lines). You can paste and send it.
server.cookies_cleared: Cookies deleted, you are logged out of Instagram.
engine.identity: Identity: {identity}, request speed: {speed}. User agent in use: {ua}
engine.quality_offered: Streams Instagram offered for this video: {list}
engine.quality_compare: COMPARISON — best Instagram offered: {best} | saved on the phone: {got} (plain version)
ui.hist_empty_text: Paste a profile or post link on the Download tab.
ui.hist_forget_confirm: Forget the download history of @{name}? Files are not deleted; the same posts may download again next time.
ui.hist_note: History is kept so the same post isn't downloaded twice. Downloaded files stay in your save folder.
ui.wz_welcome_text: Download posts, stories and highlights from public profiles, one by one or in bulk. Setup takes a minute.
ui.wz_login_text: Stories and highlights need a login. Without one, posts still download, but you may get fewer of them.
ui.wz_folder_text: Downloads are saved to this folder, with a separate subfolder for each person.
ui.wz_done_text: Paste a profile or post link and start downloading.
ui.identity_hint_desktop: Instagram may ask you to verify once after you change this. With Computer selected, the browser's own identity is used.
ui.identity_hint_mobile: Instagram may ask you to verify once after you change this. Keep Computer to look like the Windows version.
ui.report_hint_desktop: Version, computer, browser, settings and the full log in one text. It contains no cookies or passwords.
ui.report_hint_mobile: Version, phone, network, settings and the full log in one text. It contains no cookies or passwords.
server.no_network_settings: Network settings couldn't be opened on this computer.
